methods.label: Include all payments and shipping
methods.explanation:
The advertised cost includes all three payments and the shipping charge once. Its total, in dollars, is
\[
3(29.98)+9.98
=89.94+9.98
=99.92.
\]
Subtracting this from the in-store price gives the saving:
\[
99.99-99.92=0.07.
\]
Therefore the saving is \(\boxed{7\text{ cents}}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
methods.levelReason: The method requires only elementary decimal multiplication, addition, subtraction, and interpreting hundredths of a dollar.
